intro.label: Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) Services
intro.heading: Web-Mobile App Maintenance (AMC)
intro.description: Your software is a living product — it needs constant care to stay secure, performant, and competitive. Our Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services cover everything from bug fixes, security patches, and performance optimization to feature enhancements and technology upgrades. We act as your extended tech team so you can focus on your business.

process.heading: Our AMC Service Process
process.subtitle: A structured maintenance workflow to keep your application healthy and growing.

steps.title: Application Audit & Onboarding
steps.description: We start with a thorough audit of your existing application — codebase, database, security, and performance — to establish a baseline and identify immediate risks.

steps.title: SLA & Support Plan Setup
steps.description: We define clear SLAs, escalation paths, and support tiers based on your business criticality and budget.

steps.title: Proactive Monitoring
steps.description: We set up 24/7 automated monitoring for uptime, errors, performance, and security threats — catching issues before they impact your users.

steps.title: Bug Fixes & Hotfixes
steps.description: All reported bugs are triaged, prioritized, and fixed within agreed SLA timeframes. Critical bugs get emergency hotfix releases.

steps.title: Security & Dependency Updates
steps.description: We keep your app's dependencies, frameworks, and libraries up to date — patching security vulnerabilities before they become exploits.

steps.title: Feature Enhancements & Reporting
steps.description: Beyond maintenance, we help you evolve your product — adding small features, UI improvements, and delivering monthly performance reports.
